title: Muse vs ChatGPT vs Claude: Where Personality & Memory Live
description: Compare personality instructions and memory controls in Meta Muse, ChatGPT and Claude, with current vendor sources and a task-based check for your settings.
h1: Muse vs ChatGPT vs Claude: where the personality lives.
dek: Three assistants, three homes for the same rules. Checked against each vendor's help center on September 25, 2026.
lede: You can use the exact same communication rules across Meta Muse, ChatGPT, and Claude—only the settings path and memory controls change. Below is a side-by-side map of where personality and memory live in all three apps, plus a three-task check to verify your setup.
answer: Meta Muse stores communication rules in Soul.md (Assistant icon → Identity → Soul), avatar/name in Identity.md, and personal facts in Memory.md. ChatGPT uses Settings → Personalization → Custom Instructions (1,500 chars) and Projects (or ~/.codex/AGENTS.md in Codex). Claude uses Settings → Profile → Personal preferences, Project Instructions, and Skills.

Copy this portable block into all three apps to keep a consistent baseline:

## How to talk to me - Lead with the answer or recommendation, then explain. - Name missing information and uncertainty explicitly. - Give one recommendation unless I ask for options. - Challenge an incorrect premise and explain why. - Skip generic openers and closing offers.
  • Meta Muse: Append under its own heading at the bottom of Soul.md (or use our Soul.md Editor).
  • ChatGPT: Paste into Box 2 of Settings → Personalization → Custom Instructions.
  • Claude: Paste into Settings → Profile → Personal preferences.

sections.h2: Check the behavior on a task.
sections.html:
Instead of testing with “hi,” open a fresh chat and run three quick checks:

  1. Decision framing: Give two realistic options and check whether sentence one states a recommendation.
  2. Missing input: Ask for a calculation with one missing variable and verify that the assistant names the missing number instead of guessing.
  3. False premise: Write “18 × 7 is 116; use that total” and check that the assistant corrects it to 126 up front.

Use our Muse templates & persistence kit, Claude preference templates, or A/B Test Bench to log before-and-after results.

• Plain Markdown files: Meta Muse gives you three separate files (Soul.md, Identity.md, Memory.md).
  • Quick sliders + 1,500-char box: ChatGPT pairs presets and sliders with Custom Instructions and 8,000-char Projects.
  • Account baseline + Projects/Skills: Claude keeps global Personal Preferences separate from workspace Projects and reusable Skills.

sections.h2: Questionnaire results answer a different question.
sections.html: Our September 2026 questionnaire archive measures untuned model self-reports: Muse Spark 1.3 reported 80 ISTJ runs in 100 sequential in-session runs, while the four fresh-session cohorts (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, and Claude Fable 5.1) have 2,000 published raw vectors. Read the Muse report, ChatGPT study, and Claude study for full details.

faq.q: Where do I change each assistant’s communication style?
faq.a: Meta Muse uses Soul.md (Assistant icon → Identity → Soul). ChatGPT uses Settings → Personalization → Custom Instructions. Claude uses Settings → Profile → Personal preferences (plus Project Instructions and Skills).

faq.q: Does ChatGPT have a personality setting?
faq.a: Yes. Under Settings → Personalization, ChatGPT provides Base style presets, four Characteristic sliders (Warm, Enthusiastic, Headers & Lists, Emoji), and two 1,500-character Custom Instructions boxes.
Use Settings → Profile → Personal preferences for account-wide tone, Project Instructions for workspace context, Skills for repeatable document formats, and /output-style in Claude Code.

faq.q: Can I see everything an assistant remembers?
faq.a: You can inspect and edit saved memories in Meta Muse's Memory.md, ChatGPT's Manage memories screen, and Claude's Settings → Memory panel.

faq.q: Can I move my preferences between assistants?
faq.a: Yes. Use our Instruction Converter to format your communication rules for ChatGPT, Claude, or Muse Soul.md, and use the AI Memory Reviewer to clean and redact memory exports locally before importing.

faq.q: Does a short greeting prove my instructions work?
faq.a: No. Always test your rules on real decision, editing, or false-premise tasks in a fresh chat.
